fixture.notes: Boots a real WildFly 32 distribution under rust-jvm via jboss-modules.jar (NOT JPMS). The first-failure baseline below is a best-guess from JBoss Modules architecture and the known rust-jvm gaps in waves 1-7 — to be replaced with the actual stderr signature once the parent runs the harness once.

steps.name: stage
steps.notes: stage.sh / stage.ps1 download wildfly-32.0.1.Final.tar.gz to .cache/, validate sha256, extract under staged/wildfly/. Idempotent.

steps.name: run
steps.notes: run-under-rustjvm.{sh,ps1} invokes rustjvm --jar staged/wildfly/jboss-modules.jar -mp staged/wildfly/modules org.jboss.as.standalone --server-config=standalone.xml. Boot is killed by TIMEOUT_SEC (default 60) — most-likely outcome is a JBoss Modules clinit / SPI failure long before 'WFLYSRV0025: WildFly Full ... started in Nms' is emitted.

first_failure_hypothesis.most_likely: java.lang.NoClassDefFoundError on first reference to org.jboss.modules.Module / DefaultBootModuleLoaderHolder. Root cause confirmed via vm/tests/wp8_10_jboss_modules_smoke.rs probe0: classloading/src/class_manager.rs:3300 is_jdk_class() does not include the org/jboss/ prefix, so the synthetic-stub fallback in load_class (line 1167-1180) never fires for jboss-modules classes — even though synthetic_stub_fields:3811+ declares full layouts for them. NoClassDefFoundError is raised before Main.main even starts. See bench/wildfly-boot/diagnostic.md for the paste-ready fix (WP8.10.5).
alternates: After WP8.10.5 lands: secondary NoSuchMethodError on java/lang/NoClassDefFoundError.getMessage() / printStackTrace(PrintStream) — Throwable subclasses' synthetic-stub method tables don't declare these (WP8.10.7).

After WP8.10.5+8.10.7: Module.getProperty / getPropertyNames invocations from Main.main that we map to native overrides. Surface size: ~1500 LoC of native bindings already in jboss_module_loader.rs:1547+ — likely OK.
After full chain: MethodHandles.Lookup.findStatic on org.jboss.as.standalone.Main may surface classpath gaps once module.run() reaches the user-class-loading step.

known_blockers.summary: BLOCKING — extend classloading/src/class_manager.rs:3300 is_jdk_class() to include org/jboss/, org/wildfly/, org/xnio/, org/infinispan/, io/quarkus/, io/agroal/, io/undertow/, io/smallrye/ prefixes. Without this, every jboss-modules synthetic stub is unreachable. 5 LoC fix; see bench/wildfly-boot/diagnostic.md §WP8.10.5 for paste-ready code. Validated by vm/tests/wp8_10_jboss_modules_smoke.rs::probe0.

DONE this session — vm/src/vm/vm_util.rs:642 now fires post_clinit_fixup for synthetic-stub classes that have no <clinit>. Required for DefaultBootModuleLoaderHolder.INSTANCE to be populated even though the synthetic class never runs a real <clinit>.

OPEN — Throwable.getMessage / printStackTrace not registered for synthetic-stub Throwable subclasses (NoClassDefFoundError, ClassNotFoundException, etc.). Surfaces secondary NoSuchMethodError in any catch-block code path. ~30-50 LoC in lang_misc.rs.

DONE this session — RUSTJVM_JBOSS_MP_ROOT env-var fallback added to find_mp_argument so external integration tests can inject -mp value without touching argv. Two unit tests added in jboss_module_loader.rs::tests.

ServiceLoader.discover_providers via ctx.find_all_resource_bytes — confirmed landed (see roadmap §16). Re-verify under WildFly's ServiceLoader.load(MainProcessor.class) once WP8.10.5 unblocks the boot.

FileChannel.map partial — WildFly's H2 datasource and jboss-logmanager file appender both touch FileChannel APIs. Watch for UnsupportedOperationException on map/transferTo/lock once boot reaches that depth.

history.blocker: WP8.10 first-failure hypothesis only — no real boot run yet. expected_stderr_contains pinned to the conservative 'JBoss Modules' substring (banner) so diff-baseline passes only if rust-jvm gets at least far enough to emit the JBoss Modules header line.

WP8.10.5 — confirmed first-failure via deterministic smoke test (vm/tests/wp8_10_jboss_modules_smoke.rs::probe0): NoClassDefFoundError on org.jboss.modules.Module reference because is_jdk_class in class_manager.rs:3300 doesn't include org/jboss/ prefix. Synthetic-stub fallback unreachable. Paste-ready fix in diagnostic.md §WP8.10.5.

definition_of_pass: Long-term: rc=0 + 'WFLYSRV0025' in stdout + a reachable :9990 admin console. Short-term: rc matches expected_final_rc and stderr contains the pinned first-failure marker (no regression past it).
update_policy: Update this file as soon as the first real run produces a concrete first-failure. Each new failure surfaced + fixed should bump generated_at, move the previous failure into history[], and pin the next-most-distant failure as the new expected_stderr_contains target. Total expected updates: 5-30 across the WP8.10 lifecycle (each round is a 1-3 hr fix in some Wave 1-7 WP).
